messages:
kyle-procurement: Vendor Nimbus replied — they've split our Aug allocation into three waves: 40/30/30 across Aug-Sep. Wave2 slipped by ~2 weeks. They offered 5% discount for staged billing. Thoughts?

maria-supply: ack. can we push for hot-spares? request +5 units per wave to cover DOAs. forwarder availability looks tight late-Aug.

pete-ops: why does staging matter to infra? we need steady capacity in eu-west-1 for training. if wave2 slips we hit a shortfall. what's our current spare pool?

anya-qa: only 6 loaners left and those are reserved for RD test runs. reassigning will delay feature gating.

sarah-logistics: FYI Maersk provisional blackout 2026-08-15 to 08-25 in Rotterdam re: strike — if vendor ships sea, ETA +10-14d. air windows limited but possible, freight premium ~+18-22%.

kyle-procurement: @sarah-logistics can you ask Nimbus for an airquote for wave2 only and whether they can pre-clear HS code 8471.80? Also negotiate 7% if we commit to 3-wave schedule.

maria-supply: we'll accept 7% only if they include 3 hot-spares total and pre-authorized RMA credits for DOA <=5%.

pete-ops: fallback option: route some non-latency-critical jobs to us-central for 3 weeks. need quick cost compare: cloud GPU hours + egress vs expedited air + insurance.

anya-qa: moving infra affects eval cycles; expect 6-8% longer runs for retrains. test windows will slip.

sarah-logistics: rma-bot created ticket RMA-4591 for DOA pre-auth. rma-bot: "RMA ticket RMA-4591 created, linked to PO-19023, pre-authorization set to $250000, temp-loaner request pending."

kyle-procurement: Nimbus update: can add 4 hot-spares, airquote for wave2 +21%, staged billing 30% upfront / 40% on wave1 / rest on final. single AWB per wave.

maria-supply: push back on 30% upfront — propose 15% upfront with 10% performance holdback until serial reconciliation. insist on per-unit serial manifest.

sarah-logistics: customs note — if HS code changes to 8542 insurance valuation shifts; need finance signoff for declared value variance.

pete-ops: short mitigation: reduce per-job concurrency by 20% for 4 weeks and reprioritize non-prod. Ops can hold critical production by shifting scheduling windows.

kyle-procurement: decision points: 1) Accept 7% for 4 hot-spares + staged billing with 15% upfront + 10% holdback? 2) Pay +21% for air for wave2 to avoid port strike risk? 3) Approve RMA pre-auth (RMA-4591)? React :thumbsup: accept, :thinking_face: ask for redline, :no_entry_sign: reject.

maria-supply: :thumbsup: on 15% upfront + holdback, :thinking_face: on 7% unless warranty terms improve.

pete-ops: :thumbsup: on air for wave2 if cost capped at +22%. need a deploy fallback plan documented.

anya-qa: :no_entry_sign: on moving core jobs to US — too risky for release gating.

sarah-logistics: queued air booking option; asked Nimbus to confirm serial manifest format and carrier cancellation rights. I'll attach forwarder quotes to RMA-4591.

kyle-procurement: drafting PO amendment for signoff. uploading draft snippet now:

```
PO-19023-A1: staged delivery schedule; 4 hot-spare units held at vendor depot for 60 days; payment: 15% upfront, 40% on wave1, 35% on final; 10% holdback pending serial reconciliation and DOA clearance; vendor to provide per-unit serial manifest 72h before ship.
```

maria-supply: looks good, increase holdback to 12% and require carrier cancellation clause if port strike confirmed.

kyle-procurement: noted — will update and circulate for final signoff by EOD. rma-bot: "RMA-4591 updated: hot-spares requested, AWB hold option set, insurance valuation flagged."
